title: Signal
description: Something an analyzer concluded from observations. A signal is an OPINION and must never be stored in the observation stream. This is the only thing a reporting layer such as a guardian dashboard is expected to consume.

window.description: The period the conclusion is about. A signal without a window cannot be checked or expired.

subject.description: Who the signal is about, pseudonymously. Same ref space as observations.

counterparties.description: Others the signal implicates. Naming a second child to a first child's guardian is a disclosure decision the reporting layer must make deliberately - the schema surfaces it rather than hiding it.

severity.description: How much this matters if true. Separate from confidence on purpose: a high-severity, low-confidence signal is a common and dangerous shape.

confidence.description: How sure the analyzer is. Explicit so a consumer can threshold rather than guess.

analyzer.description: Provenance. When a signal turns out to be wrong you must be able to say which analyzer, which version, produced it.

evidence.description: observation_id values this conclusion rests on. A signal with no citable evidence is an assertion, and this schema does not carry assertions.

rationale.description: Plain language, written for the person who will read it. 'Played alone for four sessions after usually playing in a group of three.' If it cannot be said plainly it should not be raised.

disposition.description: What the analyzer suggests. ADVISORY ONLY - the acting platform decides. Nothing consuming this schema is granted authority over a participant. 'repair' is deliberately listed before the escalating options: it proposes that something be PUT RIGHT between the participants - an apology offered, a thing returned, an exclusion undone - rather than that anyone be reported or removed. A vocabulary whose only verbs are report and remove teaches a platform to punish, because those are the only words it has.

expires_at.description: Signals go stale. One with no expiry becomes a permanent mark on a child, which is the failure mode this field exists to prevent.

signal_class.description: What KIND of concern. Deliberately behavioural and domain-neutral - none of these names a harm, they name a SHAPE, and a shape can be checked.
